control.description-key: Counts of related rows for each option of a choice column

property.name: host
property.description-key: Any column, used only to place the control on the form. The control never reads or changes it.

property.name: recordId
property.description-key: Bind to the primary key column of the form table. Needed only when Relationship column is set.

property.name: tableName
property.description-key: Logical name of the table whose rows are counted

property.name: groupColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of a Choice, Status Reason, Status or Yes/No column on the counted table

property.name: relationshipColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of a lookup on the counted table that points at this record. Blank counts every row.

property.name: filterXml
property.description-key: Optional condition, filter and link-entity elements that restrict the rows counted

property.name: optionValues
property.description-key: Comma-separated option values to show, in this order. Blank shows every option.

property.name: badgeAction
property.description-key: Nothing, or raise the OnOptionSelect event for a form script to handle

event.name: OnOptionSelect
event.description-key: Raised when a count is selected. The handler gets the option value, label and count, and the counted table and column.
